Yen strengthens against dollar on rate hike speculation

The Japanese Yen has strengthened to a seven-month high against the US Dollar. This appreciation is attributed to increasing speculation that the Bank of Japan (BOJ) may soon raise interest rates. The Yen's rise against the dollar has been noted by financial news outlets.
